## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; weak market breadth plus narrow leadership concentrated in Energy/Materials supports the CAUTION call; tech megacaps are weak while Energy shows outsized strength. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +26.94%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.39% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials follow: DOW (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +33.04%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +7.04% | 1M: -14.47%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -4.10% | 1M: -12.43%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -8.64%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -9.75% | 1M: -16.17%) BELOW TREND.  
Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.43%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Staples pressured: EL (1W: -18.52% | 1M: -38.04%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: SLB (1W: +9.39% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +26.94%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +7.04% | 1M: -14.47%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +20.40%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +21.13%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AMT (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -7.43%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -7.88% | 1M: +7.95%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -0.57%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W momentum: SLB (1W: +9.39% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +26.94%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +7.04% | 1M: -14.47%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence: AAPL (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -7.78%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -3.84%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -2.38%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY — four large caps shifting short term, flagging tactical uncertainty and watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology is in clear weakness with multiple megacaps BELOW TREND: NVDA (1W: -4.10% | 1M: -12.43%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -8.64%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -10.16%) BELOW TREND; sector return 1W: -4.17% (24 stocks) signals broad pressure.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing selective strength/rotation: JPM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -3.84%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -2.38%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +1.39% (20 stocks) — supportive for cyclical/value exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed to weak: JNJ (1W: +0.69% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -0.10% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and selective Materials exposure given momentum (XOM, COP, SLB); reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, MSFT, META) and monitor RECOVERY names (AAPL, JPM, V, MA) for confirmation; Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while breadth remains weak.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.39% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +1.77%) ABOVE TREND — watch momentum continuation.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.10% | 1M: -12.43%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -9.75% | 1M: -16.17%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside or reversal on news.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.81% | 1M: +16.66%) — clear leader.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -4.63%) and Real Estate (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -6.08%) — continue to monitor flows away from growth/real estate.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim its 1M trend (monitor near recent 1M highs/lows for momentum shift); AAPL (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -7.78%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through above recent 1W highs; XOM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND — monitor continuation above the past month pivot; ORCL (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — watch if bullish headlines fail to arrest the downtrend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (+60): "This Decision... may be the ticket to explosive AI growth." Price/flow diverging: ORCL (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price shows distribution.  
GOOGL (+55): AI-related headlines; GOOGL (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -10.16%) BELOW TREND — news positive but price weak, watch for confirmation.  
JNJ (+55): pipeline optimism; JNJ (1W: +0.69% | 1M: -2.42%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short-term buy-side interest.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-60): regulatory/legal risk headlines and price confirming weakness: META (1W: -9.75% | 1M: -16.17%) BELOW TREND.  
OXY (-55): CEO tenure concerns in headlines but price diverging to the upside: OXY (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +26.94%) ABOVE TREND — news-driven caution despite strong moves.  
TSLA (-50): delivery/guide concerns and price confirming pressure: TSLA (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -10.85%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given weak breadth (4/11) and narrow Energy/Materials leadership. XOM (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +9.39% | 1M: +1.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -4.10% | 1M: -12.43%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -9.75% | 1M: -16.17%) BELOW TREND show clear weakness. Key risk: major short-term divergences among large caps (AAPL, JPM, V, MA RECOVERY) and mixed news flow (ORCL/GOOGL bullish headlines yet BELOW TREND; OXY bearish headlines but ABOVE TREND) — watch for confirmation before reallocating core exposure.
